rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a return to life, activity, or health.

example.english: After treatment, the patient finally began a slow revival.
example.traditional: 病人經過治療，終於慢慢復甦。
example.jyutping: beng6 jan4 ging1 gwo3 zi6 liu4 zung1 jyu1 maan6 maan6 fuk6 sou1

rows.note: Use this for renewed flourishing or popularity in culture, commerce, or other fields.

example.english: Cantonese opera has seen a revival in recent years, attracting many young people to the theatre.
example.traditional: 粵劇近年出現復興，吸引咗唔少年輕人入場。
example.jyutping: jyut6 kek6 gan6 nin4 ceot1 jin6 fuk6 hing1 kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu3 nin4 hing1 jan4 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a renewed period of religious interest or spiritual awakening, not a general revival.

example.english: This religious revival has led many people to rethink their faith.
example.traditional: 呢場宗教復興令唔少人重新思考自己嘅信仰。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 zung1 gaau3 fuk6 hing1 ling6 m4 siu2 jan4 cung4 san1 si1 haau2 zi6 gei2 ge3 seon3 joeng5
